translationRepairs: Wang Xiuzhi, whose style name was Bo Fen, came from Langya commandery in Linyi.
Wang Xiuzhi, whose style name was Bofen, came from Linyi in Langya.
臨沂 is a county within 琅邪.

He was promoted to Groom of the Crown Prince, then Left Western Attendant under the Minister of State Affairs, and Attendant Gentleman on the staff of the Prince of Guiyang in his capacity as Regional Commander.

He was promoted to Groom of the Crown Prince, then Left Western Clerk on the staff of the Minister over the Masses, and Attendant Gentleman on the staff of the Prince of Guiyang in his capacity as Minister of Works.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses. 司空 is Minister of Works.
Xiuzhi foresaw that Xiu Fan was plotting rebellion and pleaded illness rather than accept the appointment.
Xiuzhi foresaw that Xiufan was plotting rebellion and pleaded illness rather than accept the appointment.
休範 is the single given name Xiufan (Liu Xiufan).
On his return he became advisory officer on the staff of the Prince of Ancheng as Grand Marshal, then Central Gentleman.
On his return he became advisory officer on the staff of the Prince of Ancheng as General of Agile Cavalry, then Central Gentleman.
驃騎 is General of Agile Cavalry.
He later served in the same capacity on the staff of the Founding Emperor in his role as Grand Marshal.
He later served in the same capacity on the staff of the Founding Emperor in his role as General of Agile Cavalry.
驃騎 is General of Agile Cavalry.

He was given the additional rank of General Pacifying the North and reassigned as Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, but before he could take up that post he was moved to Chief Clerk on the staff of the Prince of Yuzhang as Grand Marshal.

He was given the additional rank of General Pacifying the North and reassigned as Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, but before he could take up that post he was moved to Chief Clerk on the staff of the Prince of Yuzhang as General of Agile Cavalry.
驃騎 is General of Agile Cavalry.

In the second year of Shengming he became Chief Clerk of the Left Army and Administrator of Xunyang; when the headquarters moved west he followed as Chief Clerk of the Army Pacifying the West and Administrator of Nan commandery.

In the second year of Shengming he became Chief Clerk of the Left Army and Administrator of Xunyang; when the headquarters moved west he followed as Chief Clerk of the General Who Garrisons the West and Administrator of Nan commandery.
鎮西 is the General Who Garrisons the West.
At this point the administrative staff of Nan commandery reported that the Prince of Sui's son Zilong was asking that charges be brought; Ping submitted a letter in his own defense.
At this point the administrative staff of Nan commandery reported that they had asked Zilong, Prince of Sui, to bring charges; Ping submitted a letter in his own defense.
隨王子隆 is Xiao Zilong, Prince of Sui, not his son.
He was sent out as General Assisting the State, Chief Clerk on the staff of the Prince of Sui as Army Pacifying the West, and Internal Administrator of Nan commandery.
He was sent out as General Assisting the State, Chief Clerk on the staff of the Prince of Sui as General Who Garrisons the West, and Internal Administrator of Nan commandery.
鎮西 is the General Who Garrisons the West.
Xiuzhi often said that rising as far as Chief Clerk to the Left under the Minister of State Affairs was rank enough for anyone.
Xiuzhi often said that rising as far as Chief Clerk of the Left to the Minister over the Masses was rank enough for anyone.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses.
Among Xiuzhi's clansmen was Wang Sengyou, a first cousin once removed of Grand Marshal Wang Jian.
Among Xiuzhi's clansmen was Wang Sengyou, an elder second cousin of Grand Commandant Wang Jian.
從祖兄 is an elder second cousin; 太尉 is Grand Commandant.
His father Wang Yuan had been Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
His father Wang Yuan had been Superintendent of the Palace.
光祿勳 is Superintendent of the Palace.
The Prince of Jingling, Zi Liang, heard that Sengyou played the zither well; at a banquet he had a zither brought forward for him, but Sengyou would not comply.
The Prince of Jingling, Ziliang, heard that Sengyou played the zither well; at a banquet he had a zither brought forward for him, but Sengyou would not comply.
子良 is the given name Ziliang.

At the end of the Yongming era he served as Attendant of the Crown Prince; while on duty he fell ill, his relief had not yet arrived, and he left his post without leave—the authorities reported him and he was sentenced to ransom.

At the end of the Yongming era he served as Secretarial Court Gentleman of the Heir Apparent; while on duty he fell ill, his relief had not yet arrived, and he left his post without leave—the authorities reported him and he was sentenced to ransom.
太子中舍人 is Secretarial Court Gentleman of the Heir Apparent.
Wang Ci, whose style name was Bo Bao, came from Langya in Linyi and was the son of Regional Commander Wang Sengqian.
Wang Ci, whose style name was Bobao, came from Linyi in Langya and was the son of Minister of Works Wang Sengqian.
臨沂 is a county in 琅邪. 司空 is Minister of Works.

When he was eight, his maternal grandfather, the Liu Song Grand Mentor the Prince of Jiangxia, Yigong, brought him into the inner study and spread out treasures for him to choose freely; Ci took only a plain zither and a stone ink slab, and Yigong was pleased.

When he was eight, his maternal grandfather, the Liu Song Grand Steward the Prince of Jiangxia, Yigong, brought him into the inner study and spread out treasures for him to choose freely; Ci took only a plain zither and a stone ink slab, and Yigong was pleased.

He rose through Secretary, Left Western Attendant under the Minister of State Affairs, Right Chief Clerk, Acting Administrator of Xin'an, Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, Junior Mentor to the Crown Prince while commanding the Archers Who Shoot by Sound, Champion General to the Prince of Ancheng, Chief Clerk to the Prince of Yuzhang as Regional Commander, Chief Clerk to the Left under the Minister of State Affairs, and concurrently Attendant-in-Ordinary.

He rose through Secretary, Left Western Clerk on the staff of the Minister over the Masses, Right Chief Clerk, Acting Administrator of Xin'an, Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, Junior Mentor to the Crown Prince while commanding the Archers Who Shoot by Sound, Champion General to the Prince of Ancheng, Chief Clerk to the Prince of Yuzhang as Minister of Works, Chief Clerk of the Left to the Minister over the Masses, and concurrently Attendant-in-Ordinary.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses. 司空 is Minister of Works. 司徒 is Minister over the Masses.
when the Prince of Xinye passed away, Emperor He saw his likeness and wept.
when the Lady of Xinye passed away, Empress Dowager Hexi saw his likeness and wept.
新野 is the Lady of Xinye; 和熹 is Empress Dowager Deng (Hexi).
Vice Director of the Grand Master of Ceremonies Wang Jianzhi argued: "The sovereign's name ought to be tabooed throughout the entire realm.
Vice Director of the Grand Master of Ceremonies Wang Xianzhi argued: "The sovereign's name ought to be tabooed throughout the entire realm.
Registrar of the Bureau of Ceremonies Ren Fang argued: "Li Hui drew on clear textual evidence; Wang Jianzhi's plea accords with what the heart would allow.
Registrar of the Bureau of Ceremonies Ren Fang argued: "Li Hui drew on clear textual evidence; Wang Xianzhi's plea accords with what the heart would allow.
Given lighter duties on account of illness, he was transferred to General Champion and Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of State Affairs.
Given lighter duties on account of illness, he was transferred to General Champion and Chief Clerk of the Left to the Minister over the Masses.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses.
His son Guan married Emperor Wu's eldest daughter, the Princess of Wuxian; observing all the rites of a daughter-in-law, he never once exchanged pleasantries with his mother-in-law.
His son Guan married Emperor Wu's eldest daughter, the Princess of Wuxian; she observed all the rites of a daughter-in-law, and her mother-in-law never had to return the courtesy.
The subject of 脩婦禮 is the princess.
He was offered posts as military aide on the staff of the General of Chariots and Cavalry and General Who Rapidly Attacks, and as Direct Attendant, but he declined.
He was offered posts as military aide on the staff of the General of Chariots and Cavalry and General of Agile Cavalry, and as Direct Attendant, but he declined.
驃騎 is General of Agile Cavalry.

He served successively as Companion to the Prince of Poyang, advisory officer on the staff of the Prince of Jingling as General Guarding the North and General Campaigning North, concurrently as Recorder, Gentleman of the Secretariat, Right Chief Clerk of the Minister of State Affairs, and Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, while also serving as Rectifier for his native province.

He served successively as Companion to the Prince of Poyang, advisory officer on the staff of the Prince of Jingling as General Guarding the North and General Campaigning North, concurrently as Recorder, Gentleman of the Secretariat, Right Chief Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, and Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, while also serving as Rectifier for his native province.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses.

He was sent out as Administrator of Xin'an, then recalled as Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, commanding the Archers, Regular Attendant Direct, General of Valiant Cavalry, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Commander of the Garrison Cavalry.

He was sent out as Administrator of Xin'an, then recalled as Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, commanding the Archers, Regular Attendant Direct, General of Valiant Cavalry, Palace Cadet of the Heir Apparent, and Commander of the Garrison Cavalry.
太子中庶子 is Palace Cadet of the Heir Apparent.
He was transferred to Left Chief Clerk under the Minister of State Affairs.
He was transferred to Chief Clerk of the Left to the Minister over the Masses.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses.
When Emperor Gao served as Supervisor of State Affairs and assisted in government, officials rushed shoeless to their seats, yet Yue walked in clogs without changing.
When Gaozong (Emperor Ming) served as Supervisor of State Affairs and assisted in government, officials rushed shoeless to their seats, yet Yue walked in clogs without changing.
高宗 is the temple name of Emperor Ming, Xiao Luan.

He was transferred to Minister of the Masters of Writing for Justice, promoted to Tutor to the Prince of Shaoling with the additional title Attendant Advisor, Chief Clerk to the General of Chariots and Cavalry on the staff of the Prince of Jiangxia with the additional title General Who Subdues Barbarians—all of which he declined.

He was transferred to Minister of Justice, promoted to Tutor to the Prince of Shaoling with the additional title Attendant Advisor, Chief Clerk to the General of Chariots and Cavalry on the staff of the Prince of Jiangxia with the additional title General Who Subdues Barbarians—all of which he declined.
都官尚書 is Minister of Justice.

He was transferred to advisory officer on the staff of the Prince of Shixing as Forward General and General Pacifying the West, concurrently as Recorder on the staff of the Champion, then Attendant of the Minister of State Affairs, and finally Right Chief Clerk.

He was transferred to advisory officer on the staff of the Prince of Shixing as Forward General and General Pacifying the West, concurrently as Recorder on the staff of the Champion, then Attendant Gentleman to the Minister over the Masses, and finally Right Chief Clerk.
司徒從事中郎 is Attendant Gentleman to the Minister over the Masses.

At the time Xie Tiao of Chen served as Left Chief Clerk; the Prince of Jingling, Ziliang, said to Wang Rong: "My headquarters' two senior aides—searching through past ages, with whom can they be compared?"

At the time Xie Fei of Chen served as Left Chief Clerk; the Prince of Jingling, Ziliang, said to Wang Rong: "My headquarters' two senior aides—searching through past ages, with whom can they be compared?"
謝朏 is Xie Fei, not Xie Tiao (謝脁).
At the beginning of Jianwu he was appointed Chief Clerk of the General of the Right Division, retaining his acting authority and post as Interior Administrator.
At the beginning of Jianwu he was appointed Chief Clerk of the General of the Western Division, retaining his acting authority and post as Interior Administrator.
西中郎 is the Western Division.
Gu Xianzhi of the same commandery, style name Sisi, was a grandson of Song's General Guarding the South, Kaizhi.
Gu Xianzhi of the same commandery, style name Shisi, was a grandson of Song's General Guarding the South, Kaizhi.
In youth Huiji was introduced to Prince Jiangxia of the Liu Song, Yi Gong, through maternal kinship ties. The prince admired his thoroughness and circumspection and betrothed a daughter to him.
In youth Huiji was introduced to Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia of the Liu Song, through maternal kinship ties. The prince admired his thoroughness and circumspection and betrothed a daughter to him.
Romanize 義恭 as Yigong and use the standard title order.
On returning he served as Director of the Ministry of Justice, then was transferred to head the Ministry of Personnel.
On returning he served as Minister of Justice, then was transferred to head the Ministry of Personnel.
都官尚書 is Minister of Justice.
In the third year of Yongming, owing to chronic illness, he was reassigned as Attendant-in-Ordinary with concurrent appointment as General of Agile Cavalry.
In the third year of Yongming, owing to chronic illness, he was reassigned as Attendant-in-Ordinary with concurrent appointment as General of Valiant Cavalry.
驍騎 is Valiant Cavalry; 驃騎 is Agile Cavalry.
Wang Jian, Director of the Secretariat, was the most honored figure at court. Huiji served with him in the Rites Bureau and never visited him except on official business.
Wang Jian, Director of the Department of State Affairs, was the most honored figure at court. Huiji served with him in the Rites Bureau and never visited him except on official business.
尚書令 heads the Department of State Affairs.
During the Yongming era the emperor ordered Kang to rank go players, and Prince Jingling of Jingling put Huiji in charge of the proceedings.
During the Yongming era the emperor ordered Kang to rank go players, and Xiao Ziliang, Prince of Jingling put Huiji in charge of the proceedings.
竟陵王子良 is Xiao Ziliang, Prince of Jingling.
He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
He was posthumously granted the title Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
This is an honorary office, not an enfeoffment.
In Wu commandery the cult of the spirit of Xiang Yu had long been notoriously severe; people said, "Huixiu serves the spirit scrupulously because he wants a favorable transfer."
In Wuxing commandery the cult of the spirit of Xiang Yu had long been notoriously severe; people said, "Huixiu serves the spirit scrupulously because he wants a favorable transfer."
吳興郡 is Wuxing commandery, not Wu commandery.
He was posthumously appointed Grand Master of Golden Candelabra and Purple Grandee.
He was posthumously appointed Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
金紫光祿大夫 has a standard rendering.
In the ninth year of Yongming he served as Chief Clerk on the staff of the Prince of Xiyang as Army Expelling the Barbarians, acting on the affairs of Southern Yanzhou.
In the ninth year of Yongming he served as Chief Clerk on the staff of the Prince of Xiyang as General Who Conquers the Caitiffs, acting on the affairs of Southern Yanzhou.
征虜 is General Who Conquers the Caitiffs.
Bo Bao of a great clan—his glory was to bring honor to his house.
Bobao of a great clan—his glory was to bring honor to his house.
Romanize 伯寶 as Bobao, as in chunk 002.
